entries.24e65ae6aad65330: This business manufactures and sells lubricants. Related companies include Idemitsu Lubricants America Corporation, which manufactures and sells lubricants in the United States, PT. Idemitsu LubeTechno Indonesia in Indonesia, and Idemitsu Lube Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd., which oversees the lubricants business in Southeast Asia.
entries.269e9d295f42dee4: This business generates power (thermal, solar, wind, etc.), sells electricity and conducts solar and other businesses. In the United States, Idemitsu Renewables America, Inc. builds solar power plants and sells their electricity, and power generation facilities are located at Toa Oil Co., Ltd.'s Keihin Refinery and elsewhere. Solar Frontier K.K. is a consolidated subsidiary that develops and sells solar power generation systems. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥98.2 billion (down 23.0% from the previous year).
entries.2c96262b44c995c6: This is the largest business in the group, engaging in the production, sales, export and import, and trading of petroleum refined products. In Japan, in addition to the Hokkaido Refinery, Chiba Works and Aichi Works, petroleum is refined at the Yokkaichi Refinery of Showa Yokkaichi Sekiyu Co., Ltd., the Sodegaura Refinery of Fuji Oil Co., Ltd. and the Keihin Refinery of Toa Oil Co., Ltd., among others, and sold through a nationwide network of exclusive dealers and service stations (SS). Fuji Oil Co., Ltd. became a consolidated subsidiary through a tender offer on November 5, 2025. Idemitsu Tanker Co., Ltd. transports crude oil and petroleum products, and IDEMITSU INTERNATIONAL(ASIA) PTE. LTD. (Singapore) engages in the export and import and trading of crude oil and petroleum products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6.7934 trillion (down 11.7% year on year), reflecting, among other factors, the effects of lower crude oil prices. It accounts for approximately 84% of consolidated revenue.
entries.33ad6d5bbeac717f: This is the coal business, among others. Consolidated subsidiary IDEMITSU AUSTRALIA PTY LTD (Australia) produces, procures and sells coal, and in the fiscal year ended March 2026 the company acquired additional interests in the Boggabri coal mine in Australia. IDEMITSU COAL MARKETING AUSTRALIA PTY LTD sells and trades coal. Revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥164.7 billion (down 26.8% from the previous year), reflecting price effects from the decline in coal market prices, among other factors.
